name: dprStatusBase
description: DPR: unpacked look-ups, repeat VL, EAC sessions, baseline TB result and care status codes

expressionOptions.expression: IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl6, '|', -1) + 0 >= 1000, (SELECT l.hiv_viral_load FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p2.person_id AND l.hiv_viral_load IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl6, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND l.test_datetime < DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl6, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 6 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime LIMIT 1), NULL)

IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl12, '|', -1) + 0 >= 1000, (SELECT l.hiv_viral_load FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p2.person_id AND l.hiv_viral_load IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl12, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND l.test_datetime < DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl12, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 6 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime LIMIT 1), NULL)

IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl24, '|', -1) + 0 >= 1000, (SELECT l.hiv_viral_load FROM etl.flat_labs_and_imaging l WHERE l.person_id = p2.person_id AND l.hiv_viral_load IS NOT NULL AND l.test_datetime >= DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl24, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 1 DAY AND l.test_datetime < DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl24, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 6 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY l.test_datetime LIMIT 1), NULL)

IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl6, '|', -1) + 0 >= 1000, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amrs.encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = p2.person_id AND e.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_type = 279 AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl6, '|', 1)) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl6, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 6 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY), NULL)

IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl12, '|', -1) + 0 >= 1000, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amrs.encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = p2.person_id AND e.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_type = 279 AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl12, '|', 1)) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl12, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 6 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY), NULL)

IF(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl24, '|', -1) + 0 >= 1000, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amrs.encounter e WHERE e.patient_id = p2.person_id AND e.voided = 0 AND e.encounter_type = 279 AND e.encounter_datetime >= DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl24, '|', 1)) AND e.encounter_datetime < DATE(SUBSTRING_INDEX(p2.vl24, '|', 1)) + INTERVAL 6 MONTH + INTERVAL 1 DAY), NULL)

CASE WHEN COALESCE(p2.bl_tb_screened, 0) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN p2.b_on_tb_tx = 1 THEN 4 WHEN p2.b_tb_screening_result IN (6137, 6176, 10767) THEN 3 WHEN DATE(p2.b_tb_tx_end_date) <= p2.art_start THEN 5 WHEN p2.b_tb_screening_result = 6971 THEN 2 WHEN p2.b_tb_screening_result IN (1107, 10678) THEN 1 ELSE 6 END

CASE WHEN p2.m6_person_id IS NULL THEN 6 WHEN p2.m6_status = 'active' THEN 1 WHEN p2.m6_status = 'defaulter' THEN IF(COALESCE(p2.m6_days_since_rtc, 0) <= 28, 1, 2) WHEN p2.m6_status = 'ltfu' THEN 2 WHEN p2.m6_status = 'transfer_out' THEN 4 WHEN p2.m6_status = 'dead' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

CASE WHEN p2.m12_person_id IS NULL THEN 6 WHEN p2.m12_status = 'active' THEN 1 WHEN p2.m12_status = 'defaulter' THEN IF(COALESCE(p2.m12_days_since_rtc, 0) <= 28, 1, 2) WHEN p2.m12_status = 'ltfu' THEN 2 WHEN p2.m12_status = 'transfer_out' THEN 4 WHEN p2.m12_status = 'dead' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

CASE WHEN p2.m24_person_id IS NULL THEN 6 WHEN p2.m24_status = 'active' THEN 1 WHEN p2.m24_status = 'defaulter' THEN IF(COALESCE(p2.m24_days_since_rtc, 0) <= 28, 1, 2) WHEN p2.m24_status = 'ltfu' THEN 2 WHEN p2.m24_status = 'transfer_out' THEN 4 WHEN p2.m24_status = 'dead' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END
